rows.quote: The CD data is derived from the DF11 version of the Finnish biobank study, released on June 24, 2024 [21].
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the DF11 version for the outcome data; DF11 is an alias of one dictionary row only (FinnGen DF11). For the checker: the sentence writes 'Finnish biobank study' and not the consortium name, which appears only in the title of the linked reference 21; that entry's DOI is not the dictionary row's, so it was not used as a companion source. The other passage's DF10 statement concerns the pQTL data, not this row.
